title: ✨ Ty Dolla $ign - Woke Up
description: Ty Dolla $ign song with a feature from Kanye, likely a freestyle given to him similar to "Guard Down". Has a minute of rapping and singing vocals from Kanye, as well as punch-ins and verses from Ty Dolla over the initial reference track. Samples "Paradise" by Jeremih. Mistaken as a LOVE EVERYONE track, since the producer for "Paradise" revealed Kanye had reached out Christmas 2016 for the stems - later using them to make an altered version of the song to use as background for a sentimental home video posted by Kim Kardashian to twitter. Also thought to be made later because "Paradise" wasn't released until December 2015, but it was found that the song was previewed before, with Jeremih's album having already been delayed multiple times since 2013. Original snippet leaked April 17th, 2024. Leaked after a successful Soakbuy.

title: REGULAR FIT LS TEE (H03)
description:
Background: Designed by Dora Szilagyi, the YZY GAP Long Sleeve Tee was initially planned for release in the Fall of 2022 as a part of the Holiday 2022 collection. Due to controversies surrounding Ye at the time, the collection was cancelled and first appeared in China on the Toaboa on 10/27/2022, 2 days after Gap shut down yeezygap.com.

A Ye fanpage, @dondasglory, had seen this and tweeted about it, which caused Gap to take everything off Taobao. Gap would then wait a few months to release the collection on the Chinese App, Nice, through mystery boxes, and would begin slowly liquidating their stock to 3rd parties. Yeezy would get some of this stock and put it up on yeezy.com for $20 for non-US customers; all non-poetic colors were sold on yeezy.com. (Yeezy Gap items were not sold in the US, most likely due to possible legal issues)

Referenced the YGEBB Longsleeve (2 sizes down). 

Release Date: 02/22/2024
